items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: And the bass player named Jimmy Johnson.

ctx.x: Oh, he plays trombone in the church? In the church, yeah. Mm-hmm. Well, that would be nice to hear. I bet he sounds good. Mm-hmm.

And the cause that night, the cause for me to go with them, I wouldn't live so far from that schoolhouse. And the bass player named Jimmy Johnson. Oh, yeah. He took six. They tell me I drink a whole lot of whiskey and eat cabbage, something like that. He took six. And the place was jam and pack up that schoolhouse. Oh, yeah. And he took six, they brought him to the hospital. And Bebe come at my house to get me. Mm-hmm. To finish that dance. And that's the last time I played with Louis Armstrong. And he left. And…
What did he sound like then, Louis? What kind of a trumpet player was he? Did he play the same as now or different?
